entities.name: Jana Maláčová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jana Maláčová is a Czech politician who served as the leader of the Social Democracy party from October 2024 to December 2025. In July 2018 she took up the post as the Minister of Labour and Social Affairs in the Czech Republic in the Government led by Andrej Babiš. Between March 2019 and December 2021 she was also deputy chairperson of the Social Democracy.
